notes.title: A little update (and a discount!) to celebrate the Switch launch
notes.notes:
To celebrate our Nintendo Switch release (!!!) we wanted to give a special discount here on Steam as a huge thank you for all the love and support you’ve shown us. 💛
[p align="start"]We’re also rolling out a small but handy camera shortcut update to make decorating and organizing your Camper Van even smoother and cozier. 🪴✨



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/dd62e7c4a4b1be675b72bfd801dde6b897366cfc.png"]
[p align="start"]We know this update isn’t quite as hype as Silksong news… but we’re here to be your cozy little break when you need one. 🌿☕ [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/7866bf9ffc9b6a1a33056d7b38a9ef94b198d1d2.png"]
[p align="start"]Thanks for being the best part of this journey!

notes.title: The Creative Mode update is here
notes.notes:
The Creative Mode update is here ✨🚐
This new mode lets you decorate and customize your camper van without limits. All items unlocked, new colors to try out, and even the chance to set the atmosphere just the way you like it. It’s the perfect space to slow down, experiment, and make the van truly yours 🌿💛
[p align="start"]Creative Mode includes:
🪑 Access every item in your inventory and decorate your camper van any way you like
🎨 New color options for more freedom in customization
🌦 Atmospheric effects and the ability to switch between day, evening, and night 🌞🌙
🐶 Change your pet whenever you want
🗺 Choose and change your travel destination at any time
🎵 Pick your favorite track with the music selector

We’ve also fixed many of the bugs you kindly reported here on the forums and on social media 🛠️💌

And we’ve enabled Steam Cloud, so your saves will always be safe and available no matter where you play ☁️💾

[p align="start"]We can’t wait to see your creations and share this new chapter of the journey with you 🌈✨
[p align="start"]And that’s not all… we’re thrilled to announce that Camper Van: Make It Home is coming to Nintendo Switch on September 4th! 🎮💖

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/9fb3b73fe04f662ea3e41adf4f53626648707c47.png"]

notes.title: Update 1.2 is Live!
notes.notes:
🚨 New Update is Live! 🚨 Update 1.2

We’re continuing to improve Camper Van, and your suggestions have been a huge help. Thank you so much for all the love and feedback, it’s really helping us shape the game. 💛



Here’s what’s new in this update:

🌀 Level Reset Button
You can now restart any level from the beginning, whenever you like. No need to finish it first. Perfect if you want a fresh start or need to fix a mistake.

🥕 More control over food items
You can now right-click to remove veggies, spices, legumes, and liquids from baskets. Many of you asked for more freedom when organizing food, and now you’ve got it.

🐞 Bug fixes
We’ve fixed a number of bugs to make the game smoother and more enjoyable overall.

🎧 Improved UI sounds
We updated the pick-up sounds from the interface to match the in-game grab sound, making the whole experience feel more natural and satisfying.

🎁 New collectible in the Cliff Mission
This mission had fewer collectibles, which made things a bit confusing. We’ve added a new one to make exploration clearer and more rewarding.

📖 Narrative improvements
We’ve added more details to help you get to know the traveler better, including her personality, hobbies, and tastes.

🕹️ Interactive game console
You can now interact with the traveler’s handheld console. Wonder what she’s playing today?

☕ All mugs can now be refilled
Yes, even the special ones. Now every cup can be filled to complete your perfect setup.

⚙️ New FPS limit option
We’ve added a setting to limit frame rate, which helps improve performance on lower-end PCs.

And finally, some exciting news
We’ve started working on Creative Mode, a new way to play Camper Van where you’ll be free to choose which van to decorate, where to travel, and which items to include or leave out. You’ll have access to all objects, even the ones we didn’t include in the main game because they didn’t fit the story.

This will be a free update designed to give you more freedom and make the experience even more fun and personal. We can’t wait to show you more soon.

notes.title: Camper Van 1.1. Thank you update
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you so much for all your feedback. Your messages, comments, and suggestions have helped us make the game better in so many ways 💛

Here’s what’s new:

🎬 Story & Narrative
We’ve added a short tutorial for the projector and new slides to help make the story clearer.
Oh, and there’s a little post-credits scene now too 👀

📦 Objects & Gamefeel We heard you. Having too many items was frustrating for a lot of players. We've rebalanced things and moved around some objects to make organizing more fun and less overwhelming. 🚨 Heads up! 🚨 
As we've rebalanced the game and moved around some items, you might notice a few duplicated objects in games that were already started or completed. Thanks for your understanding!

🐶 Collars for pets!
So many of you tried to put the collar on your pets... and now you finally can! 🥹

🧊 Stacking & Freezer fixes
Lots of objects can now be stacked, and we’ve improved the freezer so placing frozen food and ice cream makes more sense!

🧱 Better collision feedback
Now when objects bump into each other while organizing, there’s a little visual feedback to make it clearer what's happening.

☕ Cup placement improved
Cups can now be placed much closer together, so go ahead and create that cozy mug collection!

🐛 Bug fixes
We’ve fixed a bunch of bugs that could block progress while playing. Thanks so much for reporting them!

📸 Photo Mode improvements
Photo Mode now works as it should (no more bugs!) and we’ve added visual feedback when taking pictures, plus a clear message telling you exactly where they’re saved on your computer.

🕯️ M6 candles
Candles in Mission 6 now light up on their own and no longer cause any bugs 😅

📏 Smaller object sizes
Some items were just too big to place easily, so we’ve made a few of them smaller to help with organizing.

🌍 Post-game feature
After finishing the game, you’ll now be able to go back and revisit each mission's destination whenever you want 💫

Thanks again for being such an amazing community. We’re reading everything, so keep the feedback coming! 💌

Best,
Camper Van Team

notes.title: Demo Update & Exciting News!
notes.notes:
🎉 Demo Update & Exciting News! 🎮

Over the past few months, we’ve carefully read all your feedback and have been hard at work improving the experience. Here are some fresh updates now available in the demo:

✨ New Features:

💾 Save System: You can now save and continue your game whenever you want!
📚 New Tutorial: Get started with a step-by-step guide to learn the game basics.
🎥 Improved Camera Controls: Smoother, more comfortable controls for better game feel.
🔄 New Interactive Objects: Explore and discover new interactions in the game!
🪴 New Plants: Give them a gentle touch and feel their fluffy movement!

It gets even better! The Mac version will be ready in a few days, just in time for Gamescom (21-25th Aug.)! 🎉 We’d love to hear what you think about these changes. Don’t forget to share your feedback so we can keep improving. 👾 Also coming soon, 🎮 Controller Support: Play how you prefer with full controller compatibility.

And to top it all off, here’s a sneak peek of what we’ve been working on lately:

✨ Narrative & Details: We’re polishing the story and adding even more unique details to in-game objects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/cf43c36fffa9eed70cc230cfdbfeb13977e05f2c.png

🐾 Pets Are Coming! We’ve started with the 3D models and the design of all the related items. We can’t wait for you to meet them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/83bdef496d239bc89d94a3e9ee30ceb2ace1f2d8.jpg

🏝️ Environments Are Getting a Glow Up: We’re refining each location to make them look their best.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891235/6181024d2d045b85295147e6ba13b57d9f83beca.jpg

And if you’re heading to Gamescom, be sure to drop by and say hi! We’ve got some awesome merch ready, and we’d love to get all the love and support you can share—we really need it at this stage!
